### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. dilated cardiomyopathy 1M  —  Tier 2 — Strong / Probable  (fitness 0.632)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2472)

**Proposed mechanism:** CSRP3 (HGNC:2472) —DISRUPTS→ Sarcomere organization and integrity (GO:0030001); Sarcomere organization and integrity (GO:0030001) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital heart defect (HP:0001627); Sarcomere organization and integrity (GO:0030001) —LEADS_TO→ Dilated cardiomyopathy (HP:0011674). Mutations in CSRP3 lead to haploinsufficiency, disrupting sarcomere organization and integrity. This disruption results in both congenital heart defects (Disease A) and dilated cardiomyopathy (Disease B).

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in CSRP3 that exhibit a gain-of-function mechanism in one disease while the other requires loss-of-function would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: A pathogenic variant with a gnomAD allele frequency > 0.01% in relevant populations.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CSRP3 in sarcomere integrity could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting common downstream pathways for both congenital heart defects and dilated cardiomyopathy.
